result.topic_en: Faint formula-only calculations: integrals involving powers of x, a change of variable x = e^y, and second-order differential expressions in a function χ(y) multiplied by exponential factors $e^{\pm\frac14 y}$.
result.transcription:
$\ldots x + \int \ldots dx = \int \ldots x^{\frac{s}{2}} \ldots dx$ [?]
$= -\frac{1}{s} + \frac{1}{s-1} + \int \ldots \frac{d\ldots}{dx} \ldots dx$ [?]

$\int \psi(x)\, x^{\frac{s}{2}-1} dx = -\frac{2}{s}\int \psi'(x)\, x^{\frac{s}{2}}\, dx = \frac{4}{s(s-1)} \int \frac{d\,(x^{\frac32}\psi'(x))}{dx}\, x^{\frac{s-1}{2}} \ldots dx$ [?]

$2\psi' x = \ldots x^{-\frac12} \ldots (\frac{1}{x}+1) + 2x^{\ldots}(\frac{d\psi}{dx})$ [?]
$2x^{\frac32}\psi' x = -\frac12(2\psi\frac{1}{x}+1) + 2$ [?]
$\psi x = \chi(\log x) = \chi y$
$e^{-\frac14 y}\frac{d\,(e^{\frac14 y}\chi' y)}{dy} = e^{\frac14 y}(\chi''(y) + \frac12\chi'(y))$ [?]
$e^{\frac14 y}(2\chi(y)+1) = e^{-\frac14 y}2\chi(y)+1$ [?]
$\frac{d^2\, e^{\frac14 y}(2\chi(y)+1)}{dy^2} - \frac{1}{16}e^{\frac14 y}(2\chi(y)+1)$

methods.what: Integration by parts converting a Mellin-type integral of ψ(x) into one involving the derivative ψ'(x)
methods.quote: $\int \psi(x)\, x^{\frac{s}{2}-1} dx = -\frac{2}{s}\int \psi'(x)\, x^{\frac{s}{2}}\, dx = \frac{4}{s(s-1)} \int \frac{d\,(x^{\frac32}\psi'(x))}{dx}\, x^{\frac{s-1}{2}} \ldots dx$

methods.what: Logarithmic change of variable x = e^y, setting ψ(x) = χ(log x)
Rewriting a differential operator with exponential factors e^{y/4} in the variable y
Second-order differential expression of the form f'' − f/16 applied to e^{y/4}(2χ+1)
